page.clearConfirm: Remove every notification? This cannot be undone.
page.emptyHint: Interview invitations, offers, classroom calls and new credentials will appear here.

interview_invited.body: An organisation invited you to interview. Open Alexandria to respond.

interview_room_opened.title: Your interview room is open
interview_room_opened.body: The panel is waiting. Open Alexandria to join.

offer_sent.title: New offer
offer_sent.body: An organisation sent you an offer.

access_requested.title: Access request
access_requested.body: An organisation is asking to see your credentials.

assessment_requested.title: New assessment request
assessment_requested.body: An organisation asked you to take an assessment.

classroom_call_started.title: Classroom call started
classroom_call_started.body: A call started in one of your classrooms.

classroom_join_requested.title: Join request
classroom_join_requested.body: Somebody asked to join a classroom you moderate.

credential_issued.title: Credential issued
credential_issued.body: A new credential was added to your wallet.

guardian_request.title: Guardian request
guardian_request.body: There is a guardian link waiting for you.

settings.title: Notifications
settings.description: Badges in the app, banners from the system, and pushes to this device when the app is closed.
settings.inAppHint: Badges, the inbox, and system banners for new credentials, classroom calls and requests from organisations.
settings.pushHint: Alexandria Cloud can wake this device when an organisation sends an invitation or opens your interview room. Pushes carry no names, only the kind of event.
settings.pushUnsupported: Push is available in the iOS and Android apps. On this computer, notifications arrive while Alexandria is running.
settings.pushNoCloud: No Alexandria Cloud is configured for this network, so there is nothing to register with.
settings.pushCleanupPending: Remote removal is pending. Previously queued banners may still arrive.
settings.permissionDenied: The system is blocking banners. Allow Alexandria in the device's notification settings.
